name: ysr-support-companion
description: Windows desktop companion for Yourspotrented.com SMS support on the RingCentral line.
author: Yourspotrented.com

scripts.dev:electron: wait-on dist/main/index.js tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron .
scripts.build: npm run icons && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && vite build
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
